column10: dig_threshold_desc:I went to new planets when I felt like the next dig would give me fewer than 15 gems.
column12: surprise_desc:When the second dig result was only 10-15 fewer gems
column13: I knew I would stay longer than normal.
column15: dynamic_desc:When the second dig resulted in 40-50% fewer gems
column16: I would prepare to leave early.
